en.headline: Temporary traffic curbs in North Point for Tung Chee-hwa funeral rites
en.dek: The Transport Department will ban right turns from Java Road into King’s Road westbound on Sunday morning and close selected roadside parking spaces in Quarry Bay over the weekend.
body: The Transport Department announced temporary traffic measures in North Point and Quarry Bay to facilitate funeral arrangements for the late first Chief Executive Tung Chee-hwa at Hong Kong Funeral Home.

From 9am to 11am on Sunday, 20 September, all vehicles will be prohibited from turning right from Java Road into King’s Road westbound. The department said the restriction supports police traffic-control measures while the public memorial, encoffining ceremony and cortege take place.

Separately, from 2pm on Saturday, 19 September, until 10pm on Sunday, selected roadside metered parking spaces and motorcycle bays will be temporarily closed. These include all metered and motorcycle spaces on Healthy Street East near North Point Fire Station; two metered spaces and one disability bay on Healthy Street East near King’s Road; and all metered, disability and motorcycle spaces on Hoi Chak Street.

The wake is scheduled for 3pm on Saturday at Fuk Hoi Tong hall of the funeral home. A public memorial and encoffining ceremony begins at 9am on Sunday, after which the cortege will leave. Drivers were advised to plan alternative routes, follow on-site instructions and use public transport where possible.

zh.headline: 董建華喪禮北角臨時交通管制 周日上午禁渣華道右轉英皇道
zh.dek: 運輸署公布，周日上午9時至11時禁止所有車輛由渣華道右轉入英皇道西行，周末期間鰂魚涌多個路旁泊位亦會臨時封閉。
body: 運輸署公布臨時交通安排，配合已故首任行政長官董建華於北角香港殯儀館舉行的喪禮活動。
周日（9月20日）上午9時至11時，所有車輛將臨時禁止由渣華道右轉入英皇道西行。運輸署表示，措施為配合警方交通管制，方便公祭、大殮儀式及出殯進行。
另外，由周六（9月19日）下午2時起至周日晚上10時，鰂魚涌一帶多個路旁收費錶停車位及電單車泊位將臨時封閉，包括健康東街近北角消防局的全部收費錶及電單車泊位、健康東街近英皇道的兩個收費錶泊位（編號3107A及3107B）及一個殘疾人士泊位，以及海澤街的全部收費錶、殘疾人士及電單車泊位。
設靈定於周六下午3時在殯儀館福海堂舉行，周日上午9時舉行公祭及大殮，隨後出殯。運輸署提醒駕駛人士預早規劃行程，遵從現場指示，並盡量使用公共交通工具。
